name: Hanasaki Yukie
source: An operator at the 7th branch of W.L.O and a waitress who works at a cafe called "Pothos". She is mainly carefree, but possesses huge amounts of power, as she has trained herself in martial arts. Yukie's main mission is to ensure [url=/c34897]Yuuki's[/url] body's physical condition.
